Product features

  • Unique Design: Constructed with a durable black powder-coated metal frame, these dining chairs offer an impressive weight capacity of 220 pounds and feature an ergonomic backrest and breathable seat. Each leg also has an adjustable piece for balance on uneven floors.
  • Swivel Seat: The round cushion on this bar stool can smoothly rotate 360 degrees, making it easy to grab things and have conversations without constantly getting up or turning around. Plus, the round footrest provides added comfort in any seating position.
  • Easy Assembly: This set of 2 barstools includes all required parts, hardware, and tools with step-by-step assembly instructions to help you quickly put them together without any difficulty.
  • Versatile: These counter height stools seamlessly integrate design and function, making them suitable for a variety of occasions, including home, office, hotel, restaurant, coffee or reading shop, cafes, bars, meetings, and more.
  • Care Instructions: To maintain your indoor stools and keep them looking great, dust them regularly with a soft dry cloth and wipe up spills immediately with a damp cloth. Avoid exposure to direct sunlight or extreme temperatures, and periodically check all connections for tightness.
  • NOTE: Expertly crafted with a hand-woven paper rope seat in a natural finish, each seat features unique variations in color and texture due to the nature of the grasses used. No two pieces are exactly alike, highlighting the exclusive handcrafted quality of these stools.

Illustrated description

Features:

Introducing our beautifully crafted hand-woven bar stool that boasts an ergonomic design, ensuring maximum comfort. The thickened paper rope seat and backrest provide an extra touch of luxury while allowing for a breathable sitting experience. Whether leaning back or resting your legs on the sturdy footrest, the stool promotes better posture and relaxation for those long sitting sessions.

Our rustic and farmhouse-inspired design features clean lines and a simple seat, perfect for adding a touch of style to any space. The stool's black powder-coated metal base and legs ensure durability and prevent rust or bending after prolonged use. Additionally, the stool is rated for up to 220 lbs, making it ideal for a variety of body types.

No need to worry about potential floor damage, as our barstool comes equipped with non-slip and anti-scratch protectors to keep the stool from toppling over and protect your precious flooring. Additionally, the bar chair moves quietly, reducing disruptive noises when relocating the stool. Choose our Hand-woven Bar Stool today and add a touch of style and comfort to your home!
